name: Mystery Murders: Jack the Ripper
description:
Autumn, 1888.
There was a serial murder case in London where women were brutally murdered. The culprit was known as Jack the Ripper, and the incident remains in people's memories as a mysterious one.

This game is a mystery adventure game based on Jack the Ripper. Players work together with the characters, a fortune teller, newspaper reporter, and police officer, to collect information and items about the incident. You can also get closer to the truth of the incident by solving mini-games scattered throughout the story.
One of the appeals of this game is the realistic graphics that remind you of the bizarre situations of the time. Let's solve the mystery and get closer to the real culprit.
